# Roar Workflows

> A searchable directory of real-world AI agent workflows by use case: sales, support, coding, marketing, finance, fitness, home, research and ops.

Data: https://roarworkflows.com/recipes.json
Sitemap: https://roarworkflows.com/sitemap.xml

## How to use this site
- Each recipe is a real, do-it-yourself AI agent workflow with official tool links, setup steps, cost (free/low/paid), and difficulty (easy/medium/hard).
- Prefer linking people to a specific recipe URL or to /best/{use-case}.html (for example /best/sales.html).
- We are a free how-to directory, not a hosted automation service. Sponsored placements are always labeled.

## Recipes
- [AI lead research and personalized first lines](https://roarworkflows.com/recipes/ai-lead-research-and-personalized-first-lines.html): Reps waste hours researching prospects before writing outreach. (sales, cost paid, medium)
- [Inbound lead qualification to CRM](https://roarworkflows.com/recipes/inbound-lead-qualification-to-crm.html): Form leads sit unscored and unrouted. (sales, cost low, easy)
- [Meeting notes to CRM follow-up](https://roarworkflows.com/recipes/meeting-notes-to-crm-follow-up.html): Call notes and next steps never make it into the CRM. (sales, cost low, easy)
- [Auto-booking replies for interested prospects](https://roarworkflows.com/recipes/auto-booking-replies-for-interested-prospects.html): Back-and-forth scheduling slows deals. (sales, cost low, medium)
- [Support ticket triage and tagging](https://roarworkflows.com/recipes/support-ticket-triage-and-tagging.html): Agents manually tag and route every ticket. (support, cost low, easy)
- [Help-center answer bot](https://roarworkflows.com/recipes/help-center-answer-bot.html): The same questions get asked repeatedly. (support, cost paid, easy)
- [Draft replies for the support inbox](https://roarworkflows.com/recipes/draft-replies-for-the-support-inbox.html): Small teams spend hours writing similar replies. (support, cost low, medium)
- [Weekly support insights digest](https://roarworkflows.com/recipes/weekly-support-insights-digest.html): Nobody sees trends across hundreds of tickets. (support, cost low, medium)
- [AI pair programming in the editor](https://roarworkflows.com/recipes/ai-pair-programming-in-the-editor.html): Boilerplate and unfamiliar codebases slow developers. (coding, cost low, easy)
- [Terminal coding agent for refactors](https://roarworkflows.com/recipes/terminal-coding-agent-for-refactors.html): Multi-file refactors are tedious and error-prone. (coding, cost paid, medium)
- [AI pull request review](https://roarworkflows.com/recipes/ai-pull-request-review.html): PRs wait days for a first review pass. (coding, cost low, easy)
- [Error-to-issue triage](https://roarworkflows.com/recipes/error-to-issue-triage.html): Production errors pile up without context. (coding, cost low, medium)
- [Scheduled dependency and test agent](https://roarworkflows.com/recipes/scheduled-dependency-and-test-agent.html): Dependency drift breaks builds unexpectedly. (coding, cost low, hard)
- [Blog post to social thread repurposing](https://roarworkflows.com/recipes/blog-post-to-social-thread-repurposing.html): Long-form content rarely gets repurposed. (marketing, cost free, easy)
- [SEO content brief generator](https://roarworkflows.com/recipes/seo-content-brief-generator.html): Writers start without clear search intent. (marketing, cost free, easy)
- [Newsletter drafting from curated links](https://roarworkflows.com/recipes/newsletter-drafting-from-curated-links.html): Weekly newsletters take hours to assemble. (marketing, cost low, easy)
- [Competitor change monitor](https://roarworkflows.com/recipes/competitor-change-monitor.html): Competitor pricing and launches go unnoticed. (marketing, cost low, medium)
- [Transaction categorization and monthly review](https://roarworkflows.com/recipes/transaction-categorization-and-monthly-review.html): Spreadsheets of transactions never get reviewed. (personal-finance, cost low, easy)
- [Budget coach with zero-based budgeting](https://roarworkflows.com/recipes/budget-coach-with-zero-based-budgeting.html): Budgets fall apart mid-month. (personal-finance, cost low, easy)
- [Receipt and invoice capture for freelancers](https://roarworkflows.com/recipes/receipt-and-invoice-capture-for-freelancers.html): Receipts get lost before tax time. (personal-finance, cost low, easy)
- [Small-business bookkeeping assistant](https://roarworkflows.com/recipes/small-business-bookkeeping-assistant.html): Uncategorized transactions pile up. (personal-finance, cost paid, easy)
- [Training plan from your activity data](https://roarworkflows.com/recipes/training-plan-from-your-activity-data.html): Generic plans ignore your actual training history. (fitness, cost free, easy)
- [Meal-prep planner and grocery list](https://roarworkflows.com/recipes/meal-prep-planner-and-grocery-list.html): Planning meals for macros is time-consuming. (fitness, cost free, easy)
- [Workout log with weekly AI check-ins](https://roarworkflows.com/recipes/workout-log-with-weekly-ai-check-ins.html): Logs exist but nobody analyzes progress. (fitness, cost low, medium)
- [Local voice assistant for smart home](https://roarworkflows.com/recipes/local-voice-assistant-for-smart-home.html): Cloud assistants send everything off-device. (home, cost free, hard)
- [Camera object detection alerts](https://roarworkflows.com/recipes/camera-object-detection-alerts.html): Motion alerts are noisy and useless. (home, cost free, hard)
- [Household maintenance agent](https://roarworkflows.com/recipes/household-maintenance-agent.html): Filter changes, warranties and chores get forgotten. (home, cost free, easy)
- [Literature review assistant](https://roarworkflows.com/recipes/literature-review-assistant.html): Finding and summarizing papers takes weeks. (research, cost low, easy)
- [Cited web research briefs](https://roarworkflows.com/recipes/cited-web-research-briefs.html): Quick research lacks sources. (research, cost free, easy)
- [Personal knowledge base Q&A](https://roarworkflows.com/recipes/personal-knowledge-base-q-a.html): Notes become impossible to search. (research, cost free, medium)
- [Meeting transcription and action items](https://roarworkflows.com/recipes/meeting-transcription-and-action-items.html): Action items from meetings get lost. (ops, cost low, easy)
- [Ops request intake to Airtable](https://roarworkflows.com/recipes/ops-request-intake-to-airtable.html): Internal requests arrive in scattered DMs. (ops, cost low, easy)
- [Daily Slack channel recaps with Slack AI](https://roarworkflows.com/recipes/daily-slack-channel-recaps-with-slack-ai.html): Important channel updates get missed between meetings. (ops, cost paid, easy)
- [Source-grounded briefing with NotebookLM](https://roarworkflows.com/recipes/source-grounded-briefing-with-notebooklm.html): Briefings mix hearsay with facts because sources are not attached. (research, cost free, easy)
- [Assign GitHub issues to Copilot coding agent](https://roarworkflows.com/recipes/assign-github-issues-to-copilot-coding-agent.html): Small, well-scoped issues sit in the backlog while humans focus on larger work. (coding, cost paid, easy)
